lines.en: My iron boots crunch on the fungus.
This armor was taken from someone.

lines.zh: 我迈步还带着行军节奏。
lines.en: My stride still keeps a marching rhythm.
The shield hangs on my left arm.
My quiver is nearly empty.
I remember how a pack should weigh.
Flint and steel click at my back.
Out of my way; I am trading up armor.
This body is taller than before.
I follow the old road.
Mycelium grows in my armor's seams.
I still count my own steps.
I check the crack in my shield.
The bowstring needs replacing.
I remember how to sharpen a blade.
This body does not tire easily.
An adventurer's habits do not die.
I count the arrows I have left.
Who is rummaging through my head?
The mycelium stitches my wounds for me.
I used to keep watch like this.
The flint is still dry.
This armor no longer fits.
I wait for someone worth drawing on.

lines.zh: 手指还记得拉弓的力道。
lines.en: My fingers remember the draw.
Quiet; let me listen to the wood.

lines.zh: 盾举久了，手臂不像自己的。
lines.en: I have held the shield so long my arm feels like another's.

lines.zh: 有人在用我的声音说话。
lines.en: Someone is speaking with my voice.

lines.zh: 我把断箭削成新的箭杆
lines.en: I whittle the broken arrows into fresh shafts.

lines.zh: 菌丝在皮下走，像有小虫。
lines.en: Hyphae crawl under my skin like small worms.
Your armor is worse than mine.
Let me see what hangs at your belt.
You stand like someone trained.
Staring this long, are you not tired?
That shield of yours is new.
Your eyes are pricing my armor.
You are guessing my health, are you not?
Do not touch your sword. I move first.
There is mud on your boots.
Have we met somewhere before?
You shifted back; I noticed.
I am reading your openings.
The plate stopped it. It still hurts.
A crack runs across my shield.
That arrow went through my shoulder.
Blood runs down between the plates.
I have taken worse than this.
I snapped my own bowstring.
You aim for the old wound.
Thick plate still feels pain.
One step back, then I plant my feet.
This body grows slower by the hour.
That sword at your hip is decent.
Hand it over; let me feel the balance.
My bow lacks a good string.
That chestplate would fit me.
Lay down your weapon and I hold back.
I only want your armor.
Your gear carries an enchantment's gleam.
This smells like freshly forged iron.
A trade would suit us both.
I count to three; then you let go.
Your shoulder set my plates ringing.
The shield is up; you cannot pass.
Do not shove; the plates catch.
We collided with a clang of iron.
You stepped on my quiver.
Make way; I carry a bow.
This armor is too heavy.
Back off; my flint is hot.
Your shoulder knocked me off balance.
Iron against iron; neither yields.
We once went down a mine together.
I will mend your armor.
We take turns at watch, as always.
Two are better than one.
I remember what your pack smelled like.
We stand back to back.
Do not shoot all the arrows.
You came from a village too.
This body still remembers a handshake.
Walk together; do not fall behind.
This plate is thicker than mine.
I pick up his sword.
The dead have no need of arrows.
These boots are still wearable.
Another piece of iron for my pack.
I leave nothing for the crows.
This shield has a dent.
Pick it up; it may serve later.
My old armor can be discarded now.
The good gear is always on the dead.
I will be taking that armor.
Draw your blade; do not dawdle.
I have my eye on what you carry.
You carry a gleam I want.
Stop; let me see the full set.
How good is your archery?
I shoot first, then close in.
What will you leave behind today?
I recall a camp nearby.
You cannot outrun an arrow.
Full draw; hold my breath.
Wind from the left; aim off a touch.
Your shield does not cover your legs.
I can read the length of your stride.
First, I burn your way out.
This arrow is meant for a throat.
Do not stand so straight.
I wait for the moment you raise the shield.
Thirty paces, close enough.
Steady; miss and I switch to the blade.
A shield bash breaks your guard first.
My blade bites the seam of your armor.
Up close your shield is useless.
I set your sleeve alight with flint.
That blow costs half your health.
Your blood spatters my plate.
I have fought harder fights.
Do not face me with a wooden sword.
I have stepped on your shield.
Your armor is coming apart.
I did not choose this armor.
I woke in a field of mushrooms.
The bow is here; half the arrows are gone.
I remember entering a cave.
Who buried me here?
Mycelium threads through my ribs.
Check the gear before moving.
This is no place to make camp.
I can still draw this bow full.
Is it dawn? I cannot tell.
An adventurer never travels empty-handed.
Someone is coming; crouch down.
My own flint set me alight.
My armor rang loud when I landed.
Water pours in through my visor.
The blast tore my shield away.
Someone shot me from behind.
The spell passed straight through iron.
I cannot recall when I last ate.
The iron armor drew the lightning.
No road here, and no wind.
